title: Culdcept BEGINS Early Purchase Bonus
short_description: Enjoy special content that lets you experience the history of the series, including popular characters from past titles and Book covers. Satoshi Matsuura
full_description: About This Content Early Purchase Bonus Includes the newly illustrated characters “Zeneth” and “Najaran” that can be used as avatars, as well as two Book(deck) covers, “ Onyx” and “Culdra (1st),” that can be used in-game. ● Bonus Distribution Period October 28, 2026 (Wednesday) 00:00 (JST) – December 27, 2026 (Sunday) 23:59 (JST)
